record.question: The so called 'Look East Policy' is commonly known to be initiated under the Prime Ministership of
record.explanation: Answer B: P.V. Narasimha Rao. The Look East Policy was initiated during Prime Minister P. V. Narasimha Rao's tenure. The Foreign Ministry's compilation of the Foreign Minister's 2003 parliamentary remarks explicitly credits Rao with its formulation. Reference: https://www.mea.gov.in/Uploads/PublicationDocs/192_Foreign-Relations-2003.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
